item.title: 🔑 JWT Verification Bugs: Pin the Algorithm, Then Prove the Fix
item.description: Most JWT vulnerabilities aren't broken cryptography. HS256 and RS256 are fine. Where things go wrong is the code that's supposed to check the token: it decodes it but never verifies it, lets the token pick its own algorithm, or checks the signature and then ignores who the token was issued to.
